headline: Search is four times faster in staging; releasing it to production waits on you.

handoff.quote: search is way too slow, find out why and fix it overnight
handoff.goal: Make product search answer in under 200 ms for 95% of requests.

needs_you.title: Release the new search index to production?
needs_you.what: The new index covers product name and category together, which is what most searches filter on. On the **replay set** it brings 95% of searches from 820 ms down to 190 ms.
needs_you.pick: Release it tonight, outside shop hours
needs_you.why: Building the index locks writes to the products table for about 4 minutes, so nobody can edit products while it runs.

options.name: Tonight
options.cost: 4 minutes without product edits at night

options.name: Now
options.gain: Fast search an hour from now
options.cost: 4 minutes without product edits during shop hours

done_in_your_name.what: Deleted 12 old staging database snapshots (40 GB).
done_in_your_name.why: Your note "clean up whatever is in the way", and staging had run out of disk.

done_in_your_name.what: Merged the cache fix into the main branch.
done_in_your_name.why: Your standing rule: review, then merge.

your_messages.outcome: Kept out of scope; no worker edited it.

workstreams.goal: Find out why search is slow
workstreams.result: Search read the whole products table on every request, because no index matched the filters it uses. That one cause explains **about 90%** of the time spent.

steps.did: Recorded the **replay set**: 1,000 real search requests in staging.
steps.found: 95% of them took up to 820 ms.
steps.why_next: Look at where that time goes.

steps.did: Asked the database to explain its plan for the slowest searches.
steps.found: Each one read all 2 million product rows.
steps.why_next: Add an index for the filters searches use.

evidence: Staging, with a copy of last week's production data.
The replay set, replayed three times.

workstreams.goal: Make search answer in under 200 ms
workstreams.result: With the new index, 95% of searches answer within **190 ms** in staging, down from 820 ms.

media.caption: Search time per request, before and after the index.

evidence: Staging only; production has more traffic, so expect slightly slower numbers there.
workstreams.distance: One step: releasing the index to production.

changed_beliefs.before: The search cache was the bottleneck.
changed_beliefs.now: The cache was fine; the database read every row.
changed_beliefs.affects: The planned cache rewrite is no longer needed.
